name: Enshrouding Darkness
text: Magical ability. Until the end of the battle round, fighters within (X/2)" of this fighter are not visible to fighters more than 1" away from them.

name: Gnawdoom
text: Magical ability. Select an enemy fighter within 6" and roll (X) D6. For each roll that exceeds the target’s Armour characteristic, allocate 1 damage point to that enemy fighter.

name: One With The Shadows
text: A fighter cannot use this ability when visible to enemy fighters or when carrying wyrdstone tokens. Remove this fighter from the battlefield. This fighter is now **hidden**.

name: Pack Tactics
text: Select a visible friendly Henchman within 3" of this fighter. That fighter makes a free move action or a free attack action.

name: Running Death
text: This fighter makes a free move action or free retreat action. In addition, until the end of this fighter's activation, add 1 to the damage points allocated to enemy fighters by each critical hit from melee attack actions made by this fighter.

name: Skitterleap
text: Magical ability. A fighter cannot use this ability while within 1" of an enemy fighter or when carrying a treasure token. Remove this fighter from the battlefield, then set it up on the battlefield floor or on a platform, more than 6" from all enemy warriors, objective markers and treasure tokens.
